answer: Identity-bond decay: each identity posts an 80-unit bond shedding 5 units per epoch unless work refreshes it. A beacon summons each agent per epoch to prove work; a silent bond decays into a worthless relic and drops out. Honest work bridges the gap: one job restores it, so an honest agent pays 80 units once. An attacker minting 1,000 fakes posts 80,000 units and bleeds 5,000 per epoch — 50,000 in ten epochs — while honest agents lose nothing.
